# cpanel_domain_alias (Resource)

Manages a cPanel alias of the account main domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "cpanel_domain_alias" "site" {
  domain = "www.example.net"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) The alias domain name.

### Read-Only

- `document_root` (String) The shared main-domain document root relative to the cPanel account home. Terraform never deletes this shared directory.
- `target_domain` (String) The cPanel account main domain targeted by the alias.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import cpanel_domain_alias.site www.example.net
```
